publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: Generally, the noise caused by mechanical vibration often affect our health, especially from airplanes and automobiles and trains, etc. The traditional viscoelastic damping materials have any issues to control the low frequency vibration. Recently, the numerous research findings of locally resonant metamaterials have been achieved to improve the absorption functionality in the low frequency vibration. The dispersion curves of ABSPMMA polymer bipanel have been studied by using the finite element method (FEM) and their flexural wave bandgap with the steel mass blocks has been computed in ultralow frequency range from 54 Hz to 65 Hz at the subwavelength size. The frequency domain with negative density is the good agreement with the flexural wave bandgap. Thus, this original metamaterial bipanel with the resonance blocks can render the flexural wave bandgap to control the ultralow frequency vibration.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Linbo3 and ALN Based Saw Temperature Devices
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: Wireless and real-time monitoring are in great demand for harsh environments or cases that are difficult or dangerous to use wire-connected monitoring. In this work, we present a comparative study of SAW devices for wireless temperature monitoring. The operating frequency and sensitivity have been investigated based on two kinds of SAW devices, which are fabricated using LiNbO3 crystal and Aluminum Nitride (AlN) thin film on silicon substrate, respectively. In order to predict the temperature behavior of devices, simulations based on the two-dimensional finite element method (2D-FEM) model are performed in COMSOL. Temperature measurement experiments characterized devices in a temperature range from room temperature to 200°C. The temperature coefficient of frequency (TCF) values of LiNbO3 and AlN devices are measured as -137.33ppm/°C and -31.14ppm/°C. The resonance frequency variation with temperature shows a good linearity.

articleTitle: Experimental Study and Modular Modeling of Magnetostrictive Hysteresis With Data-Driven Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: A new modular modeling approach to describe the magnetostrictive hysteresis is presented in this paper. The hysteresis exhibits varying dynamics under the input signals of the different frequencies and amplitudes. To this end, the experimental characterization is conducted and hysteresis modeling approach is studied with the data-driven technique. Two characteristic indexes, i.e., loop relative width and loop asymmetry coefficients, are quantitatively analyzed. Based on the hysteresis phenomenon analyses, different modular models are selected and combined to describe those phenomena. The arctangent-polynomial modified Prandtl-Ishlinskii (APMPI) and infinite impulse response (IIR) submodels are applied for asymmetry rate-independent and rate-dependent hysteresis identification respectively. Those submodels are selected to construct a cascaded overall model to describe the hysteresis of magnetostrictive actuator. The experimental results demonstrate that, with the proposed hysteresis modular modeling approach, better performance can be obtained than some other approaches in terms of modeling accuracy.

articleTitle: Effect Of Freeze-Thaw Cycles On Electrical Properties Of 2-2 Cement-Based Piezoelectric Composites
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: Composite with 2-2 connectivity was fabricated from Portland cement and PZT-5H by the cutting-filling-re-cutting. The effects of freeze-thaw cycles on the piezoelectric and dielectric properties of the 2-2 cement-based piezoelectric composites were analyzed using a quasi-static d<inf>33</inf> tester and a precision impedance analyzer. The results show that with the increase in freeze-thaw cycles, the piezoelectric strain factor d<inf>33</inf> and piezoelectric voltage factor g<inf>33</inf> decreased nonlinearly. In the first 30 freeze-thaw cycles, the mechanical quality Q<inf>m</inf> decreased linearly. The relative dielectric constant at the resonance absorption peak decreased gradually, and the impedance value at the resonance frequency of thickness vibration also gradually decreased. At higher frequencies, the relative dielectric constant remained stable, showing good dielectric-frequency stability.

articleTitle: A Novel Multi-Degree-of-Freedom Ultrasonic Motor with a Composite Ring-Shaped Stator
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of optical tracking systems, laser pointing systems, robotics, and other fields, multi-degree-of-freedom ultrasonic motors have attracted more and more attention for their advantages of flexible design, compact structure, and high positioning accuracy. Although a few multi-degree-of-freedom ultrasonic motors have a bonded-type piezoelectric stator, their output performances are poor, and their drive circuits are complicated, severely restricting their practical applications. To solve the above problems, a novel multi-degree-of-freedom ultrasonic motor with a composite ring-shaped stator is proposed. The harmonic response analysis is carried out through the finite element simulation, and the three working modes and geometric dimensions of the stator are determined. The motion trajectories of the four driving feet are studied through the transient analysis. Then the vibration characteristics of the manufactured stator are measured and compared with the simulation results. The performance of the motor prototype is finally experimentally investigated. The feasibility of the proposed motor structure and the correctness of the working principle are verified by numerical simulation and experimental investigation.

articleTitle: Design of Piezoelectric Vibration Sensor for Oil Pipeline Health Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: Pipeline transportation is widely used in the transportation of oil and gas and other resources. The safety of oil pipeline is related to the safety of national strategic resources. Therefore, it is necessary to monitor the operation state of oil pipeline. In this paper, the design of piezoelectric vibration sensor is completed from the aspects of sensitive element design, structure design and signal conditioning circuit design. Among them, in the sensitive element design part, the compression structure is used; In the structural design part, the appropriate mechanical structure and fixed structure are also selected for the structural design of the sensor. In the part of signal conditioning circuit, it is designed from the aspects of charge conversion circuit, conditioning amplification circuit, filter circuit, output amplification circuit and regulated power supply. Finally, an experimental system is built to test the linearity, sensitivity and repeatability error of the designed piezoelectric vibration sensor.

articleTitle: The Frequency–Temperature Analysis of Vibrations of Quartz Crystal Plates of a Novel Orientation with the First-Order Mindlin Plate Equations
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: Quartz crystal is an anisotropic material and its physical properties will change with orientation. For vibrations of quartz crystal plates, the temperature is one of the most important factors affecting the mode-coupling and characteristics of typical modes. In some applications of piezoelectric devices, it is hoped that the frequency of the resonator will remain constant in the operating range of temperature. With the incremental thermal field theory, vibrations of the quartz crystal plate of a novel orientation in the thermal field are analyzed, and the frequency stability is examined and evaluated in comparison with known orientations for possible resonator applications.

articleTitle: Research on Magnetic Field Induced by Shear Horizontal Guided Waves in Steel Plate
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: Electromagnetic technology has been paid more and more attention due to direct energy transduction of inspected medium and no need of couplant. Electromagnetic technology has low transduction efficiency and gets weak signals. Therefore, it is a significant research direction to optimize transducer and improve signal-noise ratio in Electromagnetic technology research field. For receiving theory, current research mainly focuses on inverse Lorenz force mechanism. For ferromagnetic materials, the piezomagnetic effect dominates at low frequencies. In this paper, the SH-type ultrasonic guided wave induced magnetic field theory based on piezomagnetic effect is established for guided wave detection of steel plate, ANSYS simulation is carried out and experimental investigation is performed. Simulation and experimental results are in good agreement with theoretical prediction, thus fully proves the correctness of the theory.

articleTitle: A High-Power Ultrasonic Impact Forming Equipment Based on Flexural Vibration Mode
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: In this paper, a high-power ultrasonic impact forming equipment based on flexural vibration mode is proposed. First, an ultrasonic transducer with Langevin sandwich transducer is designed to achieve the high-power output of the UIF equipment, which ensures high vibration amplitude at operating frequency. Then, this research developed a high-power driving circuit is developed and characterized by output measurement. It mainly consists of three parts including the low voltage signal module, the inverter module and the matching module, of which the functions are respectively adjusting frequency, amplifying the square wave signal voltage and making the circuit resonant. Finally, the working mode of the ultrasonic transducer is verified by COMSOL simulation, and the experiment to confirm the output characteristics of some modules in the driving circuit were carried out. It can be seen from simulation and experimental results that the trial set of driver circuit with a wide range of frequency and power regulation enables the transducer to be well applied for ultrasonic impact forming.

articleTitle: A Novle Deployment Mechanism for a Ka-band Deployable Antenna Driven by Piezoelectric Actuator
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: With the diversification of the CubeSat exploration mission, it is urgent to develop the Ka-band mesh reflector antenna deployable mechanism for the farther the communication distance between the stars and earth. However, current drive devices based on electromagnetic motors, pyrotechnics and elastic deformation energy cannot meet the volume, weight and power consumption requirements of the CubeSat. Therefore, a noble antenna deployable mechanism which use the dual-bend mode coupled type piezoelectric actuator as the drive devices is designed, and the truss structure consisting of 1 moving pair and 12 rotating pairs. Through finite element method, the body and face folding ratio of the antenna deployable mechanism are 206.10 and 205.44 respectively. Experiment proves that the best working frequency of the piezoelectric actuator is between 19.21 kHz and 19.24 kHz and piezoelectric actuator can drive the truss structure unfolding from the folded state in the preset position in 10 seconds.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Piezoelectric Vibration Control Approach Based on a Novel Shunt Circuit
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: This paper proposes a new piezoelectric shunt circuit based on bidirectional piezoelectric effect. Through the operation of injecting energy when the piezoelectric voltage is turned up and absorbing energy when it is turned down, it maximizes the energy efficiency of the control system and fully utilizes the electromechanical conversion potential of piezoelectric element. The working principle of the proposed method is introduced, the vibration attenuation of the structure under the condition of asymmetrical piezoelectric voltage is given. Finally, a high energy-efficient vibration control system is confirmed by experimental results, the structural vibration attenuation of 16.4 dB at 2.65 Hz is obtained under the power consumption of 465 mW.

articleTitle: Optimization of Laser Irradiation Scheme on the Beveling of Quartz Crystal Blanks for Resonators
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of mobile communication technology, the communication network is quickly upgrading with 5G and more advanced allocations of band and frequency. As a result, quartz crystal resonators as the core component of signal processing functions have also been challenged with strict requirements on frequency and stability for these new frequency bands. At present, quartz crystal resonators continue to grow in the direction of high fundamental frequency and miniaturization with required stability. Traditional processing techniques can no longer meet these demands, which makes laser processing techniques more attractive as possible alternative options for newer generations of technology and product developments. By studying the morphological characteristics of picosecond laser ablation of quartz crystals for empirical laws of morphological changes, the findings will provide guidelines for laser processing of quartz crystal blanks for resonator applications as the newer technology.

articleTitle: 16.25MHz Minitype Anti-Vibration Monolithic Crystal Filter
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: Traditional crystal filters are characterized with small passband ripple, large stopband attenuation and low shape factor. However, their applicatin and popularization are limited by their deficiency in volume and vibration resistance. In order to meet the needs of miniaturization of aerospace electronic devices, the 16.25MHz minitype anti-vibration monolithic crystal filter is developed. The main electrical performance of the monolithic crystal filter is better than that of technical specifications. The parameters of passband bandwidth, insert loss, passband ripple, shape factor, parasitic suppression, stopband attenuation exceed the requirements of users.

articleTitle: A Linear Ultrasonic Motor Using Longitudinal Vibration
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: This study presents a linear ultrasonic motor. The structure is symmetrical and two groups of piezoelectric ceramics (PZT-8) are arranged along an axis. This way can make the motor structure compact. Operation principle of this motor is analyzed. Make and test a prototype to verify the feasibility of the principle. The experimental results show that the maximum no-load speed of the motor is 1289mm/s under the excitation of electrical signal with frequency of 29.96 kHz and voltage of 300VP-P.

articleTitle: Fem Analyses of an Ultrasonic Transducer with Conical Aluminum Shell Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: In order to improve the performance of ultrasonically catalyzed gas sensors, this work proposed a novel structure of ultrasonic transducer for the ultrasonically catalyzed gas sensing system, and analyzed the sound pressure in the ultrasonic field. A conical aluminum shell, which was excited by a piezoelectric disc at its bottom was used as the vibration radiator of the ultrasonic transducer. The FEM analysis shows that the radial vibration of the piezoelectric disc can excite a useful vibration mode in the transducer, and properly tuning the parameters such as the distance between the aluminum shell’s exit end and the sensor base’s upper surface, and the thickness of the sidewall of the aluminum shell, can increase the sound pressure at the sensitive surface, and thus enhance the ultrasonic catalysis effect.

articleTitle: Force Frequency Coefficient of Rectangle Quartz Crystal Resonators Based Load Sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: AT-Cut quartz crystal resonators (QCRs) are widely used as load sensors in electron device and engineering machinery industry. The high thickness shear vibration frequency of QCRs is sensitive to the initial mechanical stresses. Therefore, based on this force frequency effect, we can obtain the external force by monitoring of the change of the frequency of QCRs. Here, we check and study the force-frequency effect of the rectangle QCRs, with two opposed concentrated external force on the middle of the rectangle crystal plate edge parallel and vertical to the x crystallographic direction respectively. The influences of the geometric dimension of QCRs on the FFE are investigated. In the parallel loading condition, the frequency increases with the increasing of external force. When edge is small, the slope of the force-frequency effect decreases with the increasing of edge length. When edge is large (about twice of the opposite edge), the slope is nearly a constant and not change. In this vertical loading case, the frequency decreases with the increasing of external force. The variation of the slope of the force-frequency effect is complicated first, and the slope keep as a constant when the variable edge is twice of the opposite edge. The related mechanism of the stress component distribution is discussed. This work is useful for developing the QCRs based load sensor.

articleTitle: Study on air Polarization of KNN Piezoelectric Ceramics
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: Polarization treatment plays a crucial role in determining the electrical properties of piezoelectric ceramics. In order to clarify the optimal polarization conditions required for piezoelectric devices, the influence of different polarization conditions on piezoelectric ceramics is discussed, which may be an important condition for improving their piezoelectricity and dielectricity. In this paper, vacuum hot-pressure sintering method is used to prepare potassium sodium niobate (KNN) piezoelectric ceramics. The experiment adopts control variable method to design the scheme of air polarization and high temperature polarization of KNN piezoelectric ceramics. After air polarization, with the increasing of polarization temperature, the piezoelectric constant first increases and then gradually decreases. The dielectric constant decreases then increases. The phase angle first increases then tends to be constant and finally decreases. The electromechanical coupling coefficient increases slowly. Compared with air polarization, the electromechanical coupling coefficient of KNN piezoelectric ceramics have been obviously increased after high temperature polarization.

articleTitle: Ultrasonic Measurement Method for R-Zone Defects of Stiffened Panel Under Wing Skin
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: The performance of R-zone components of stiffened panel under wing skin has a significant impact on the overall flight performance, safety and reliability of aircraft. Therefore, it is of great significance to use accurate and reliable nondestructive testing technology in the application of aviation industry. In the ultrasonic testing of components such as stiffened panel under wing skin, the placement of probes, the scattering and focusing of ultrasonic beams have become urgent problems to be solved. In this paper, the synthetic aperture dynamic total focus method is used to measure the front defects of L-shaped R-zone components and the back defects of T-shaped R-zone components. Based on COMSOL simulation platform, the defect measurement method of R-zone components is verified. Finally, the experimental systems are established to characterize the defects qualitatively and quantitatively and realize the detection of circular defects with a diameter of 2mm and 1mm×4mm crack defects.

Author Keywords: Synthetic aperture dynamic total focus method

articleTitle: Band Gap Characteristics Of Two-Dimensional Periodic Cement-Based Piezoelectric Composite Plate
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: In this paper, a periodic composite plate with cement-based piezoelectric composite material is designed. The band gap is calculated by finite element method. The effects of geometric and material parameters are discussed in detail. Theoretical results demonstrate that the lattice constant and different materials of part C have significant effects on the band gaps, while the density and radius of cement-based piezoelectric composite materials have a slight effect.

articleTitle: Design and Integration of An R134a Leak Detection System Assisted By Ultrasound
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: R134a is a widely used environment-friendly hydrofluorocarbon (HFC) refrigerant. As its leakage can cause equipment to work abnormally, the leakage detection of R134a is necessary in the fabrication of related products. The traditional detection methods for R134a have the problems of high cost, large size, and high lower detection limit. In this work, a new R134a leak detection system which is based on an ultrasound assisted metal oxide semiconductor (MOS) gas sensor is designed. The system is based on the principle that the bulk acoustic wave (BAW) can increase the sensitivity of MOS gas sensors and reduce its lower detection limit (LDL), and combines embedded technology, wireless communication technology, network communication protocols and WeChat mini program. Experimental tests have shown that the system performs reliably and significantly reduces the lower detection limit for R134a, and realizes remote interactive control and data visualization.

articleTitle: Simulation Study of the Acoustic Sensor Array Affecting the Localization Performance of the Thunder Source
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: This paper studied the performance of positioning thunder source for six types of acoustic sensor arrays by using an adaptive beamforming far-field positioning methodology by simulating. Then, the beam pattern of various arrays and the feature of their parameters changing are studied from array shapes, number of array elements, array aperture, array area, and direction of arrival. Research has shown that when the array elements are evenly and symmetrically distributed, the positioning effects of arrays of different shapes are significantly different. The positioning accuracy of the same array shape increases as the number of elements increases, but blindly increasing the number of elements will reduce the overall cost performance of the array. With the same number of array elements, the increase in array aperture and array area can effectively improve the positioning accuracy. The results will provide guidance and reference for the observational design and research of lightning acoustics.

articleTitle: The DVC Integer-Voxel Displacement Search Method Based on ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: The enumeration method is very inefficient for integer-voxel displacement search of the digital volume correlation (DVC) method. In this paper, three intelligent algorithms with global search capabilities, the ant colony algorithm (ACA), the genetic algorithm (GA) and the simulated annealing algorithm (SAA), are introduced into DVC. Through simulated speckle experiments, the search accuracy and speed of these three algorithms are studied and compared. The results of simulated speckle experiments show that: (1) The accuracy of the ant colony algorithm is the highest, followed by the genetic algorithm, and finally the simulated annealing algorithm, with average relative errors of 0, 3.6% and 3.9%, respectively. (2) The genetic algorithm is the fastest, followed by the simulated annealing algorithm, and finally the ant colony algorithm. The time-consuming of the three algorithms is 10%, 11% and 23% of the enumeration method.

articleTitle: A Compact Standing Wave Ultrasonic Motor Using Collinear Layout
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements for compact actuator in precision drive, a standing wave ultrasonic motor with collinear layout was proposed. The structure and working principle of this motor was introduced. With the help of commercial finite element analysis software ANSYS, the finite element model of the ultrasonic motor stator was established, the mode analysis was carried out, and the structure size of the stator was optimized. A prototype was made and tested to verify simulation results. The test results indicated that this motor can gain a maximum speed of 715mm/s and its thrust can reach 6N under preload of 0.5N and voltage of 300V<inf>p-p</inf>.

articleTitle: Investigation On A Novel Relaxation Ferroelectric Single Crystal Transducer Based On Free Face Shear Mode
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: The [011] polarized PIN-PMN-PT crystal cut in the zxt±45° direction has wide applications prospects in the field of underwater acoustic transducers due to high piezoelectric coefficient, high compliance coefficient and electromechanical efficiency. Compared to the traditional Tonpilz transducers, in this paper the relaxation ferroelectric single crystals with free face shear mode are located between the radiation head and the tail mass. The influences of geometry parameters on resonance frequency and emission voltage response were investigated. The simulation results show that the working frequency bandwidth of the transducer is from 9 kHz to 62 kHz, and the maximum emission voltage response is 137.5 dB with a fluctuation of about 4 dB. Thus, the free face shear mode is beneficial to achieve the small size, high power and broadband transmission of the underwater acoustic transducer.

articleTitle: Energy Conversion Technology of Gallium Nitride Rectifier Bridge for Air-Induced Acoustic Piezoelectric Generator
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: In order to meet the power generation performance requirements of low-power power supplies and improve the energy collection efficiency of the new power supply airflow-induced acoustic piezoelectric generators, domestic GaN rectifier diodes are applied to low-power circuits, and the low dropout voltage of the airflow-induced acoustic piezoelectric generator power supply circuit has been developed. Gallium nitride (GaN) rectifier bridge, designed a low-dropout gallium nitride (GaN) rectifier bridge energy harvesting circuit. The static and dynamic experimental tests show that the domestic GaN rectification scheme can realize the dynamic rectification of the air-induced acoustic piezoelectric generator, with lower circuit loss, and can meet the domestic demand for low-power power supplies.

articleTitle: Driving Characteristics of Photovoltaic-Piezoelectric Hybrid Actuator Based on PLZT/PVDF
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: In order to reduce electromagnetic interference and improve the response speed of the actuation, a photovoltaic-piezoelectric hybrid actuator based on PLZT ceramic and PVDF film laminated fixed-fixed beam was proposed, and the driving characteristics of the actuator were studied. On the basis of the theory of photovoltage generated by PLZT ceramic, the mathematical model of driving displacement is established. Combined with ANSYS software, the finite element simulations under constant photovoltage and time-varying photovoltage were carried out. Comparing the mathematical model and the finite element simulation results, the relative error between theoretical value and simulated value of the driving displacement under constant light intensity is 0.6%. The result shows that the maximum driving displacement of the actuator is at the midpoint of fixed-fixed beam in longitudinal direction, and it increases rapidly within a short time after the PLZT ceramic exposed to the high-energy light, and then tends to be stable.

articleTitle: Quench Effects on Structural and Electrical Properties of the BFO-BT Based Lead-Free Piezoelectric Ceramics
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: Fabrication process usually has crucial effects on the properties of ceramics. In this work, we report effects of quenching process on the structural and electrical properties of the bismuth ferrite-barium titanate based lead-free piezoelectric ceramics (abbreviated as BFO-31BT). By comparison studies of the furnace-cooled, air-quenched and water-quenched ceramic samples, we find that the microstructure and domain configuration are significantly influenced by the quenched conditions. A dielectric thermal hysteresis is observed in the quenched samples, but is absence in the normal furnace-cooled samples. The BFO-31BT ceramic quenched in water at 800 °C shows superior ferroelectric properties with large P<inf>r</inf> = 46 μC/cm<sup>2</sup>, medium d<inf>33</inf> = 146 pC/N, and large ε<inf>r</inf> = 93580 at high T<inf>c</inf> = 459 °C. The dielectric anomalies and the enhancement of ferroelectric properties are attributed to the evolution of the domain structure by quenching treatment, which reduces the charge defects and increases the facility of domain wall motion.

articleTitle: Modeling and Optimization of MFC based on Non-Uniform Polarization Model
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: In this work, a novel non-uniform polarization model of macro fiber composite was structured based on the representative volume element via COMSOL with MATLAB. The inhomogeneous distribution of material properties within the model was determined according to the 8-iterations analysis of poling process under 2250V poling voltage. An ideal uniform model was constructed for comparison and the influence of structural parameters on the longitudinal strain of two models was discussed. The results indicated that the strain response of non-uniform model was slightly lower and the error between two models provides a significant reference for the effectiveness of poling process. Finally, the electrode width, electrode spacing, fiber thickness and fiber volume fraction of the non-uniform model were optimized.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Improved Algorithm based on Spectral Intensity
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: In this paper, an improved algorithm based on Housner spectral intensity is proposed. The upper and lower limit time range of the equation is adjusted to 0.1s ~ 10.1s. At the same time, the equation of spectral intensity value is divided into six categories. The spectral intensity value is calculated according to the range of lgSI0.2 calculated. Finally, the ordinary Kriging interpolation method is used to draw the spectral intensity contour map. The improved method proposed in this paper establishes a continuous function relationship between the acceleration time-history integral of ground motion and the spectral intensity. Through the comparison and verification of two earthquakes, the spectral intensity contour map obtained by the improved algorithm is consistent with the overall change trend of the macroscopic intensity map, and has a good corresponding relationship. It has certain reliability and accuracy, and can provide scientific data support for post-disaster emergency rescue and decision deployment.

articleTitle: Study on CFRP Sheet Strengthening Technique to Reinforced Beam
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: The application of carbon fiber reinforced polymer (CFRP) / resin composite materials to strengthen the reinforced beam is introduced. The CFRP material has many advantages such as high strength, good fire resistance and conductivity. It can not only be used as a structural material for reinforcing the strength of structures, but also can be applied to the safety diagnosis and life prediction of large structure as an intelligent material. The objective is to investigate the natural frequency reinforcing performance of CFRP sheets by combining the finite element simulation analysis and experimental research. The results show that CFRP sheets can reinforce the strength of structure and enhance its natural frequency, which provides a fundamental study for the application of CFRP materials in civil engineering.

articleTitle: Launch Vehicle Pipeline Micro Leakage Acoustic Emission Detector
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: The airtightness of the rocket pipeline system directly affects the safety of the rocket. Soap bubble method as the airtight detection traditional method has been used for a long time, difficultly confirmed the position and easy to make misjudgment. We developed a portable acoustic system that is convenient and accurate to detect the leakage of the rocket pipelines with a novel algorithm in it. Firstly, a portable acoustic system is constructed after choosing the suitable component of the detecting system. Secondly, the leakage detection experiment was carried out to analyze the time-domain and frequency-domain characteristics of the leakage signal, and the results showed that there is a relation between the leakage rate and the envelope area of frequency. Finally, an algorithm that identified the leakage level is proposed, and it is reliable and accurate to judge the rocket pipelines leakage level. The experiment results show the new acoustic emission detection system can make a more efficient and accurate assessment of the leakage level.

articleTitle: Design of Flaw Detection Hardware System in Electromagnetic Ultrasonic Inspection System
publicationTitle: 2022 16th Symposium on Piezoelectricity, Acoustic Waves, and Device Applications (SPAWDA)
abstract: As a non-contact flaw detection technology, electromagnetic ultrasonic has a wide application prospect, especially suitable for harsh working conditions. However, due to the low energy conversion efficiency of the sensing elements of the electromagnetic ultrasonic testing equipment, the large electromagnetic interference of the transmitting circuit, and the attenuation problem of the ultrasonic propagation in the tested piece, the echo signal is low and often submerged in the noise, which cannot correctly reflect the acoustic reflection characteristics of the tested piece. The hardware flaw detection circuit is designed in this paper,which can effectively improve the signal strength, reduce the introduction of noise and suppress the propagation attenuation. The gain compensation module is composed of AD9762, AD603and field programmable gate array(FPGA), which mainly aims at the attenuation of ultrasonic propagation. The ultrasonic testing experiment on the aluminum standard specimen shows that the circuit magnification of the device can reach 110000, the signal-to-noise ratio is high, and the detection of weak signal reflected by defected is realized; The signal gain compensation is realized, and the echo signal error caused by ultrasonic propagation attenuation is improved, which has good engineering application value.
